sentences.en: Today, at a lecture on linguistics, I rehabilitated Russian linguists.
sentences.zh: 今天，在一场语言学讲座上，我重新评价了俄罗斯的语言学家。

sentences.en: He was rehabilitated at the end of the Fifties.
sentences.zh: 他在五十年代末得到了平反。

sentences.en: In the late Fifties, he was rehabilitated.
sentences.zh: 到了五十年代末，他得到了平反。

senses.zh: 使康复；使恢复名誉；使恢复原状
复兴；复权；恢复正常生活

mnemonic: reh（重新）+abili（能力）+tate→重新获得能力→恢复
